_doc: Quarry Bowl: two rubble walls split the floor into three lanes, open at the top and bottom. Tanks smash shortcuts through them (Craglash's Landslide Charge, Cairn's Rockslide Rush); everyone else goes round. Rects are [col, row, width, height] in 8 px cells on the 84x36 grid.
name: Quarry Bowl

tiles._doc: The floor is tiles (assets/arenas/quarry.tscn, built by tools/build_tiles.gd from this block; the recipe tools/tile_recipes/rock.json): Mountains sandstone scree; worn tan-dirt cart lanes along the inside of each rubble wall (Set 1's blob, ragged sides); a raised, rounded middle (Desert v2's packed-earth blob9 with its sandstone ledge along the south side, decor by pos, its rock tops over the patch's bottom row); cobbled loading corners; the walls as runs of stacked rock (styles.wall) that leave rock heaps where smashed. Rects are [tx, ty, w, h] in 32 px tiles (2 x 2 cells).

light._doc: low afternoon sun from the top left: long shadows raking right

grade._doc: dusty low sun, a sandy cast; a view-only tint and vignette (GradeView), eased at night/sunset/rain by weather.json

ambient._doc: dust hanging in the low sun, grit trickling off the rubble walls, a dust devil now and then; see AmbientView
